_comment: Example chart input file — copy this to YYYY-MM.json (e.g. 2026-06.json) and replace each track with a real release. Every track must be a verifiable real release on a real label; no fabricated chart positions. The generator script (scripts/generate-monthly-chart.js) reads this file by its YYYY-MM filename and the keys below; the leading underscore in this filename keeps the template file out of the YYYY-MM glob the generator uses.

tracks.title: Example Track Title
tracks.label: Example Label
tracks.review_en: One- or two-sentence editorial review in English explaining why this track earned the position. Reference the breakdown, the bassline, the vocal, the BPM, the label context — whatever made it land.
tracks.review_ja: 英語と同じ位置を獲得した理由を説明する、1〜2文の日本語編集レビュー。ブレイクダウン、ベースライン、ボーカル、BPM、レーベル文脈などを参照する。
